mechanism: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

hypothesis.mechanism: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist
context_requirements: Functional GABAA receptor complexes with benzodiazepine-sensitive subunit composition
Neuronal lineage or ectopic expression of GABAA receptor subunits
Membrane potential and chloride gradient permissive for GABAergic modulation
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of GABA-receptor or neuronal gene expression signatures after treatment
Shared transcriptional response across multiple lines that correlates with GABRA/GABRB/GABRG expression
